issue.body:
### Motivation
- Establish a governance-first repository layout and automation scaffold for research-only signal discovery and controlled self-improvement. 
- Enforce safety constraints (no live trading, no auto-merge, branch-based automation) and provide auditable, append-only artifacts for proposals, approvals, and simulations. 
- Provide structured schemas and registries so proposals, evidence scorecards, and candidate signals can be validated and traced. 
- Add an alerts watcher to surface research-only market conditions and persist run history for audit. 

### Description
- Add multiple GitHub Actions workflows including `draft-pr-generator`, `feedback-ingest`, `perp-research-alerts`, `repo-self-review`, `simulation-validation`, and `weekly-evolution-report` to automate feedback ingestion, draft PR creation, self-review, schema validation, simulation placeholders, and scheduled reports. 
- Introduce JSON Schema definitions under `docs/schemas/` (`improvement_proposal.schema.json`, `candidate_signal.schema.json`, `evidence_scorecard.schema.json`) and a large set of governance and design docs (`docs/REDESIGN_PLAN.md`, `DATA_SCHEMAS.md`, `RESEARCH_LAB_REDESIGN.md`, etc.). 
- Add core repository artifacts and append-only registries and examples including `improvement_proposals/`, `experiments/`, `approvals/`, `candidate_signal_registry/`, `registries/active_config.json`, `dashboards/metrics_snapshot.json`, and starter entries such as proposals, simulations, evidence, and hypothesis history. 
- Add a research-only watcher script `scripts/perp_research_alerts.py` that polls public endpoints (Binance/Gate), writes history snapshots, and creates/updates GitHub issues labeled `research-alert`. 
- Update `README.md` to reflect the governance-first, research-only mission and add numerous README placeholders across components (feature/hypothesis/evaluation engines, memory store, etc.). 

### Testing
- No automated tests were executed as part of this PR. 
- CI workflows were added to run schema checks via `simulation-validation` (uses `python -m json.tool` against schema files) when triggered. 
- The `feedback-ingest` job produces `feedback_ingest/classified_feedback.json` and uploads it as an artifact when run. 
- The `perp-research-alerts` workflow runs `scripts/perp_research_alerts.py` and uploads `alerts/history/*.json` snapshots when triggered.

------
